description: This file defines the SiloConnectionMaintainer class responsible for managing connections to silos in Orleans runtime, handling silo status changes, and closing connections to dead silos.

classes.name: SiloConnectionMaintainer
classes.description: Manages connections to silos, listens to silo status changes, and closes connections to dead silos.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Subscribes to silo status events upon startup.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Unsubscribes from silo status events upon shutdown.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to lifecycle events for runtime initialization.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles status change notifications, closes connection if silo is dead.

methods.name: CloseConnectionAsync
methods.description: Closes the connection to a specified silo asynchronously, with delay and exception handling.
